Indexation URLs

Source: R/sacha_clb.R
indexations.Rd

Retrieves the URLs of the pages that describe a species in external taxonomic platforms. URLs are built from the identifiers returned by the configured source and from the links supplied by a custom fetcher (see sacha_configure()). The default adapter provides identifiers for Catalogue of Life, GBIF and iNaturalist, and for other platforms when the source records them. The platform shortcuts (ipni_url(), gbif_url(), inat_url(), col_url(), wfo_url(), tpl_url(), itis_url(), ncbi_url(), irmng_url(), worms_url() and eol_url()) are documented on this page.

indexations(species, identifier = NULL, language = NULL)

indexations_md(species, identifier = NULL, language = NULL)

ipni_url(species, language = NULL)

gbif_url(species, language = NULL)

inat_url(species, language = NULL)

col_url(species, language = NULL)

wfo_url(species, language = NULL)

tpl_url(species, language = NULL)

itis_url(species, language = NULL)

ncbi_url(species, language = NULL)

irmng_url(species, language = NULL)

worms_url(species, language = NULL)

eol_url(species, language = NULL)

Arguments

species

Character scalar with a scientific name of at least a genus and a specific epithet, for example "Bidens andicola". Surrounding and repeated whitespace is removed. Vectors of length greater than one, NA and single-word names are rejected with an error.

identifier

Optional platform to keep: one of the registry codes listed in Registry codes, one of the accepted aliases, or the name of a link supplied by a custom fetcher. NULL (default) returns every available platform. Unknown values raise an error.

language

Language of labels and messages: a YAML basename in inst/lang/ (for example "en" or "es") or a declared alias (for example "english" or "spanish"). NULL (default) uses the language set with sacha_configure(). It does not translate the citation. Unsupported values raise an error.

Value

  • indexations() and the platform shortcuts: a named character vector of URLs, with platform names as names; empty when no URL is available.

  • indexations_md(): invisibly, a Markdown line with a bold localized "indexed in" label followed by one link per platform, or "" when no URL is available. The line is also written to the console.

Registry codes

The values accepted by identifier are:

  • "col": Catalogue of Life.

  • "gbif": GBIF.

  • "inat": iNaturalist.

  • "ipni": International Plant Names Index.

  • "wfo": World Flora Online.

  • "tpl": The Plant List.

  • "itis": Integrated Taxonomic Information System.

  • "ncbi": NCBI Taxonomy.

  • "irmng": Interim Register of Marine and Nonmarine Genera.

  • "worms": World Register of Marine Species.

  • "eol": Encyclopedia of Life.

The aliases "catalogue of life", "catalogue_of_life", "inaturalist", "i naturalist", "world_flora_online" and "the_plant_list" are also accepted. Matching is case-insensitive.

Platform shortcuts

Each shortcut is equivalent to calling indexations() with the corresponding identifier and accepts only species and language: ipni_url() (IPNI), gbif_url() (GBIF), inat_url() (iNaturalist), col_url() (Catalogue of Life), wfo_url() (World Flora Online), tpl_url() (The Plant List), itis_url() (ITIS), ncbi_url() (NCBI Taxonomy), irmng_url() (IRMNG), worms_url() (WoRMS) and eol_url() (Encyclopedia of Life).

See also

sacha_configure(), accessors-sacha

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
indexations("Bidens andicola")

indexations("Bidens andicola", identifier = "gbif")

indexations("Bidens andicola", identifier = "catalogue of life")

indexations_md("Bidens andicola")

indexations_md("Bidens andicola", identifier = "inat", language = "es")

gbif_url("Bidens andicola")

ipni_url("Bidens andicola")
} # }
